Fork of braces 3.0.3 (MIT). Original license retained. This is a local security patch, not an upstream release. Pattern parsing rejects >4096 characters, >32 brace groups or depth >32 before recursive consumers run. Expansion is capped at 4096 intermediate items and numeric ranges at 1000. Build globs use this package through an explicit npm override. The nested-brace DoS advisory is addressed by input rejection; regression tests exercise the bound. AST APIs are internal to the toolchain and must not accept externally supplied objects.
